text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for production-gpu-cluster (eu-west-1). GPU queue length > 1200, queue growth sustained for 6m, autoscaler failed to add nodes. Priority: P1.
oncall_miriam: I’m on it. Jumping into cluster and autoscaler logs.
infra_kyle: noted, ping me if it's launch-template/iam related — seen similar with the new instance-profile rollout.
sre_jess: Quick customer impact note: several customer pipelines are seeing token-generation timeouts, some requests returning 503s due to queue throttle. CS informed.
oncall_miriam: Autoscaler events show repeated create-nodegroup attempts then immediate failure. Copying logs: ```E0412 10:21:44 autoscaler.go:231] failed to create nodegroup: error creating ASG: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation on resource launch-template/l-abc123```
infra_kyle: that looks like a launch template -> instance profile permission issue. New launch-template version was rolled out last night, might be missing the assume-role ARN.
eng_raj: We rolled the LT v12 to prod at 02:00 UTC. I pushed an IAM change but didn't realize the instance profile ARN was different in eu-west. Checking diff.
ops-bot: Reminder: escalated to infra oncall per runbook (tag: autoscale-iam).
sre_jess: Mitigation plan: 1) try manual scale to existing GPU nodegroup in another ASG; 2) if that fails, patch autoscaler fallback to smaller-gpu instance types to handle urgent queues; 3) notify customers and enable degraded mode.
oncall_miriam: Manual `kubectl scale --replicas` won't help here (pods pending due to no nodes). I'll try provisioning a temporary GPU node by spinning an adhoc instance via cloud console (requesting k8s join script).
infra_kyle: If you need a quick unblock, I can add a new launch-template alias with the old working IAM profile and trigger the ASG create. Authorizing now.
oncall_miriam: Trying ASG create with LT v11 (known-good) -> failed earlier because autoscaler still attempted v12. I'm patching the cluster autoscaler config to point at nodegroup template override.
eng_raj: Heads up — we may need a rolling revert of LT v12 for eu-west. I can prepare the revert PR but will need infra sign-off.
sre_jess: Customer comms: CS_olivia, can you post a short status in the tenant incident channel noting elevated latencies and that we're working on capacity? Include ETA ~30-60m.
cs_olivia: Will do. Drafting: "We're investigating elevated GPU inference latencies in EU. Engineering is provisioning capacity and expects partial mitigation within 30-60 minutes. Some jobs may be queued or time out." Sending now. :white_check_mark:
oncall_miriam: Autoscaler now logs successful ASG create but nodes fail to join with kubelet taint error: ```node "ip-10-0-22-45" taint check failed: missing cloud-provider tag, rejecting```
infra_kyle: That indicates the instance metadata script didn't apply the k8s tags (launch template userdata likely missing cloud-init variable). We need the userdata from v11. I'm pushing a quick patch to LT v12 userdata to include the tag step.
eng_raj: Patching LT v12 userdata now and rolling a new version v13. After that we'll force a scale by setting desiredCapacity+2 on the ASG.
ops-bot: :information_source: Handoff scheduled at +45m if unresolved — paging next oncall (sre_jess) in 30m.
sre_jess: I'll be the next contact. Miriam, keep me posted on node join success. Also capture exact error strings for postmortem.
oncall_miriam: LT v13 rolled. Triggering ASG scale to +2. Watching cloud-init logs: nodes are now running cloud-init, kubelet starts, join token accepted.
eng_raj: I see nodes Ready in the cluster. Pods are scheduling on new GPUs. Queue length dropping: 1200 -> 430 over 12m.
sre_jess: Nice. Re-enable normal routing for customer pipelines gradually. Keep throttling thresholds in place for another 30m.
cs_olivia: Updated customer note: "We have added capacity and see improved throughput, queues are draining. Monitoring continues; we’ll send another update in 30m."
oncall_miriam: Current status: capacity restored, autoscaler continues to show intermittent create failures — root cause: launch template v12 had both IAM role mismatch and missing userdata tag step. Rollback recommended for LT v12 across regions until we have full validation tests.
infra_kyle: Agreed. I'll open an infra change to revert LT v12 globally, and add a preflight CI check for userdata + instance profile mapping.
sre_jess: Postmortem action items captured. Assigning owners: revert LT v12 (infra_kyle), add CI checks (eng_raj), better alerting to detect autoscaler create/access errors (sre_jess).
oncall_miriam: Closing immediate pager. If anything regresses, re-open. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident resolved (P1 -> P2) at 2110994854. Runbook: start postmortem and tag with `autoscaler,launch-template,iam`."
